visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a black Insta360 Ace Pro 2 camera against a desert background. A large white number '3' is overlaid on the center of the screen, indicating a countdown. (2) The scene transitions as the number changes to '2' and then '1' while the hand continues to hold the device. The background shows a vast, sunny sandy terrain. (3) A young woman with a white hat and red top stands in a desert field surrounded by numerous colorful hot air balloons rising into a clear blue sky. She looks at the camera with a joyful expression. (4) The camera follows the woman from behind as she runs toward the massive Great Pyramid of Giza under a bright midday sun. The ground is dry and yellowish sand. (5) The woman, now wearing a flowing white dress and headband, walks along a wooden ramp toward the entrance of the Abu Simbel temple, which features enormous seated stone statues. (6) Close-up views show hot air balloons with roaring flames being inflated, followed by a shot of a horse-drawn carriage stationary in front of a pyramid in the desert.
